channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro negociou com Vorcaro R$ 134 milhões para filme sobre Jair
item.description: Messages and audio reveal a negotiation between Senator Flávio Bolsonaro and banker Daniel Vorcaro for R$ 134 million in financing for the film 'Dark Horse', a biopic about former president Jair Bolsonaro. The deal involves private funding for a cinematic production aligned with the Bolsonaro family's political narrative.

item.title: Amazon, Shein e Shopee e outras lojas virtuais removem 'taxa das blusinhas' após decisão de Lula
item.description: AliExpress, Amazon, Magazine Luiza, Mercado Livre, Shein and Shopee removed the so-called 'blusinhas tax' on international purchases up to US$50 after President Lula signed a provisional measure that eliminates the federal tax in that range. The companies, certified under the Remessa Conforme program, stopped charging the tax, complying with the new federal rule. The change aims to reduce costs for consumers buying low-value imported goods.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro admite que procurou Vorcaro para recursos filme e nega que ofereceu vantagens
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) admitted he contacted Daniel Vorcaro, owner of Master, to seek funding for a film about his father, former President Jair Bolsonaro. He denied offering or receiving any advantages in exchange for the financial support. The statement comes amid speculation about his potential 2026 presidential candidacy.

item.title: Em grupo, bolsonaristas debatem substituição de Flávio por Michelle, após áudio pedindo recursos para Vorcaro
item.description: Allies of Jair Bolsonaro are discussing replacing Flávio Bolsonaro with Michelle Bolsonaro in the 2026 presidential race after leaked audio showed the senator negotiating funds with banker Daniel Vorcaro to finance a biopic. Ricardo Salles (NOVO-SP) stated in a WhatsApp group that if Flávio loses traction in polls, Michelle would be the ideal replacement. The revelation sparked division among supporters, with some preferring Lula’s re-election over backing Michelle, while the Bolsonaro campaign called an emergency meeting to assess the scandal’s impact on polling.

item.title: Tarcísio responsabiliza Sabesp e Comgás por explosão no Jaguaré
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas held Sabesp and Comgás accountable for the explosion in the Jaguaré neighborhood, stating that regulation would be enforced with a 'heavy hand', despite the state being a shareholder. He visited the affected area and pledged that the companies would be held responsible for the damages.

item.title: Governo diz que medidas sobre gasolina preservarão meta fiscal
item.description: The Lula government stated that measures to curb gasoline price increases, including subsidies of up to R$0.89 per liter, will not alter the fiscal target, as costs will be offset by higher revenue from oil dividends and royalties. Minister Bruno Moretti emphasized fiscal space exists to absorb the measures and that spending contingencies would be triggered if extraordinary revenues fall short, ensuring fiscal goals are met.

item.title: STF oficializa Dias Toffoli para compor TSE no lugar de Cármen Lúcia
item.description: The Supreme Federal Court (STF) symbolically approved the appointment of Minister Dias Toffoli as a titular member of the Superior Electoral Court (TSE), replacing Carmen Lucía, who stepped down ahead of schedule. This completes the STF-originated bench in the TSE, now comprising Nunes Marques (president), Toffoli, and André Mendonça. The plenary also formally appointed Flávio Dino as a substitute member of the TSE.

item.title: PT aciona PF contra Flávio Bolsonaro após mensagens com dono do Banco Master
item.description: The leader of the PT in the Chamber, Pedro Uczai, announced that the party will file a complaint with the Federal Police and the Federal Revenue Service following the disclosure of messages attributed to Senator Flávio Bolsonaro in conversations with banker Daniel Vorcaro, owner of Banco Master. The PT will request the lifting of banking and fiscal secrecy to investigate possible irregularities in the mentioned transactions.

item.title: Zanin acompanha Mendonça e vota por rejeitar ação sobre monitoramento de jornalistas e parlamentares
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Cristiano Zanin voted against the action challenging the Bolsonaro government's monitoring of journalists and parliamentarians, siding with André Mendonça's dissent. This brought the virtual trial's vote to 4-2 in favor of declaring the measure unconstitutional. Zanin argued that while monitoring dissidents to stifle public debate is unconstitutional, there is insufficient evidence that the acts were carried out with that illicit purpose, advocating for the dismissal of the Green Party's representation.

item.title: ‘Dark Horse’: o que é o filme que virou pivô da maior crise da campanha de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: The film 'Dark Horse' is an English-language biopic about Jair Bolsonaro, directed by Cyrus Nowrasteh and written by Mário Frias, starring Jim Caviezel as the former president. Flávio Bolsonaro sought private financing from banker Daniel Vorcaro of Banco Master to cover the film’s expenses, denying any use of public funds, though leaked audio shows him pressing for overdue payments and using familial language.

item.title: Explosão em SP: Tarcísio diz que ‘a mão pesada do Estado vai atuar e a punição vai acontecer’
item.description: Governor Tarcísio de Freitas visited the areas affected by the Sabesp explosion in Jaguaré, promised housing assistance, and stated that the State will enforce a 'heavy hand' to punish the concessionaire for failing to meet service targets, despite its privatization in July 2024. He emphasized that the State remains both a shareholder and regulator, and will hold concessionaires accountable, including applying contractual sanctions.

item.title: Pesquisa aponta que fake news sobre eleições miram urnas eletrônicas
item.description: A Projeto Confia research reveals that over 45% of election-related fake news in recent Brazilian electoral cycles targeted the functioning of electronic voting machines, exploiting public technical ignorance to sow distrust in the electoral system. Recurring false claims include alleged delays in the 'confirm' button and automatic number completion, with verification hindered by infrequent public contact with the machines (every two years). The study analyzed over 3,000 contents from the 2022 and 2024 elections, selecting 716 for qualitative analysis, aiming to build counter-narratives and rapid response strategies for the 2026 elections.

item.title: Após áudio de Flávio a Vorcaro, governistas pedem CPI do Master e quebra de sigilos de filho de Bolsonaro
item.description: Members of the government bloc in Congress have called for the immediate installation of a CPI to investigate alleged irregularities at Banco Master, following the release of an audio in which Senator Flávio Bolsonaro negotiates with banker Daniel Vorcaro the transfer of $24 million to finance the film 'Dark Horse', a biopic of Jair Bolsonaro. PT leader in the Chamber, Deputy Pedro Uczai, also requested the breaking of Flávio Bolsonaro’s banking and fiscal secrecy, questioning the origin, tax declaration, and legality of the funds, as well as the close political and personal relationship between the senator and Vorcaro, who refer to each other as 'brother'.

item.title: 'Fala, irmãozão', 'estarei contigo sempre': veja mensagens entre Flávio Bolsonaro e Daniel Vorcaro
item.description: Text messages between Flávio Bolsonaro and banker Daniel Vorcaro reveal pressure for payments tied to the production of the film 'Dark Horse', about Jair Bolsonaro, with Vorcaro transferring R$ 61 million to a U.S.-based fund linked to Eduardo Bolsonaro. Flávio used informal terms like 'brother' and 'mermao' in the conversations, including audio messages and stickers, and said the film's positive impact could have an 'effect elevated to minus one'. The leak coincided with a spike in the dollar, which closed at R$ 5, and Flávio described the matter as 'private money' when questioned by reporters.

item.title: Tarcísio evita comentar áudio de Flávio a Vorcaro: “Não é pauta”
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas declined to comment on the audio in which Senator Flávio Bolsonaro requested financing from banker Daniel Vorcaro for the film Dark Horse, stating the matter is not on the agenda during a public event.

item.title: Deputada do PSOL aciona Mendonça e pede prisão preventiva de Flávio por tratativas com Vorcaro
item.description: Deputy Sâmia Bomfim (PSOL-SP) urged Supreme Court Justice André Mendonça, rapporteur of the Master case, to assess the need for precautionary measures — including possible preventive detention — against Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) over negotiations with Daniel Vorcaro to finance a film about Jair Bolsonaro.

item.title: Flávio confirma pedido de dinheiro a Vorcaro, mas diz que era privado
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro confirmed he privately solicited sponsorship from Daniel Vorcaro for the film 'Dark Horse', about his father’s trajectory, denying any quid pro quo, use of public funds, or political influence. He stated the contact began after the Bolsonaro administration ended and before public accusations against Vorcaro emerged, and called for a CPI on Banco Master to investigate alleged frauds.

item.title: PEC da Anistia trava e oposição mira PL sobre golpe de Estado
item.description: The opposition in the Chamber stated that the Amnesty PEC lacks sufficient votes for approval in 2026, an election year, and is instead prioritizing Bill 6.012/2025, which seeks to repeal crimes against democracy, including violent abolition of the Democratic Rule of Law and coup d'état — offenses for which Jair Bolsonaro was convicted. Deputy Zé Trovão (PL-SC) argued these crimes did not occur, as there were no weapons or troops deployed, and accused the STF of applying illegal parameters to convict political opponents.

item.title: Oposição diz que pesquisa reflete 'máquina pública a favor' de Lula, mas vê limite em melhora
item.description: Bolsonarist leaders interpret Lula's slight recovery in the Quaest poll as an early sign of public machinery being used in his favor, though they note limits to the improvement. The poll shows a modest rebound in Lula's support, still below pre-2022 election levels. The opposition claims the government is deploying state resources to boost the president's image.

item.title: STF elege Toffoli para vaga no TSE, e Dino assume posto de substituto em ano eleitoral
item.description: The STF elected Minister Dias Toffoli to occupy a seat in the TSE, replacing Carmen Lúcia, and appointed Flávio Dino as his substitute, in a move occurring months before the 2026 elections. The change in the TSE's composition may affect the judgment of the clarification appeals in the case of former Rio governor Cláudio Castro, with new rapporteur Ricardo Villas Bôas Cueva and potential reevaluation of the conviction for abuse of power. Toffoli and Dino are seen as uncertainty factors, possibly altering majorities on ineligibility and the annulment of Castro's diploma.

item.title: Master pagou R$ 2,3 mi a empresa que financiou filme de Bolsonaro
item.description: Banco Master paid R$ 2.3 million to Entre Investimentos, a company linked to founder Daniel Vorcaro, to finance the film 'Dark Horse' about Jair Bolsonaro. The payment is part of a larger R$ 134 million agreement between Flávio Bolsonaro and Vorcaro, with transfers made between February and May 2025 via the U.S.-based Havengate fund. Vorcaro and his financial operator Fabiano Zettel have been imprisoned since March 2026 in Operation Compliance Zero.

item.title: Caiado cobra clareza, Zema cita ‘tapa na cara’ e Renan pede ‘cadeia’ após áudio de Flávio e Vorcaro
item.description: Three right- and center-right pre-candidates in the 2026 Brazilian elections — Ronaldo Caiado (PSD), Romeu Zema (Novo), and Renan Santos (Missão) — publicly criticized Flávio Bolsonaro for seeking funds from Daniel Vorcaro to finance a film about Jair Bolsonaro, demanding transparency, calling the act 'impermissible,' and in some cases calling for criminal liability. Caiado urged clarity in public-private relations, Zema labeled the request a 'slap in the face of honest Brazilians,' and Renan advocated for the senator’s imprisonment, following confirmation of the audio’s authenticity by Estadão and revelations of negotiations involving up to US$ 24 million.

item.title: Clima na pré-campanha de Flávio é de fim de festa após divulgação de áudio com Vorcaro
item.description: The atmosphere in Flávio Bolsonaro's pre-campaign turned sour after an audio surfaced in which he asks banker Daniel Vorcaro for money to finance a biopic about his father, Jair Bolsonaro. Vorcaro's bank, Banco Master, received regulatory advantages under the Bolsonaro government and is linked to major fraud involving public funds from pension institutes, sparking accusations of hypocrisy and undermining Flávio's credibility on anti-corruption rhetoric. Pre-candidate Romeu Zema (NOVO) called the audio a 'slap in the face' and said Flávio lacks moral authority to criticize PT corruption cases.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro fala sobre pedido de dinheiro a Daniel Vorcaro — veja vídeo
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro admitted requesting R$135 million from Daniel Vorcaro, owner of Banco Master, to finance the film 'Dark Horse', about his father Jair Bolsonaro’s life. He claims the funds were private and no public money was involved, despite STF investigations into alleged irregular parliamentary amendment transfers. Audio and message revelations by The Intercept show a close relationship between the two, potentially harming Flávio’s voter intent, as he had been leading in 2026 election polls.

item.title: Empresário confirma ter intermediado repasses de Vorcaro a Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Businessman Thiago Miranda confirmed he intermediated negotiations between Senator Flávio Bolsonaro and former Master Bank CEO Daniel Vorcaro for the transfer of R$ 62 million to finance a film about Jair Bolsonaro’s life. The initial negotiation was for R$ 134 million, but the amount was reduced due to Master Bank’s financial crisis, which led to its liquidation in November 2025. Miranda also stated he attempted to arrange a meeting between the two on December 11, 2024, but Flávio Bolsonaro did not attend.

item.title: Após 'linha cruzada', EUA oferecem US$ 100 milhões em ajuda a Cuba, mas exigem que Igreja Católica seja intermediária
item.description: The United States has offered $100 million in humanitarian aid to Cuba, conditioned on distribution through the Catholic Church, amid escalating diplomatic tensions and mutual accusations. The Cuban government denies the offer was made through official channels, calling it a 'fable', while Trump maintains Cuba is a 'failed nation' and Lula condemns the U.S. embargo.

item.title: Bancada do PT pedirá a PF quebra de sigilo de Flávio e ministro pede cassação do senador
item.description: The PT caucus, alongside PCdoB and PSOL, will request the Federal Police to break the banking and phone secrecy of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) following revelations that he messaged banker Daniel Vorcaro seeking funds to finance a film about Jair Bolsonaro’s life. The party will also seek information from the Federal Revenue, request document seizures in the U.S. and Brazil, and push for a Congressional Investigative Committee (CPI) on the Master bank scandal. PT members argue Flávio should be stripped of his mandate, while government officials say he must explain himself to the public.

item.title: Sóstenes e Rogério Marinho deixam Congresso e devem ir à sede do PL após matéria do Intercept
item.description: Opposition leaders Sóstenes and Rogério Marinho left Congress and are expected to go to the PL headquarters following an Intercept report revealing alleged financing by Daniel Vorcaro, owner of Master, for a film about Jair Bolsonaro's life. The lawmakers avoided commenting on the matter at the request of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, a pre-candidate for president.

item.title: Relação entre Flávio e Vorcaro precisa ser investigada a fundo. diz Uczai
item.description: Pedro Uczai (SC), leader of the PT in the Chamber of Deputies, called for a 'thorough' investigation into the relationship between Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), a pre-candidate for president, and the owner of [name not specified in the content], alleging suspicious links that require rigorous scrutiny.

item.title: Dólar bate R$ 5 após reportagem vincular Daniel Vorcaro e Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: The dollar rose nearly 2% to R$ 5 after The Intercept Brasil reported that presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro negotiated with former banker Daniel Vorcaro the payment of R$ 134 million to finance a film about Jair Bolsonaro. The revelation sparked market concern, amplifying exchange rate volatility amid suspicions of private funds being used for electoral campaign purposes. The linkage between political figures and financial actors raised questions about transparency and potential violations of campaign finance laws.

item.title: Flávio pediu dinheiro a Vorcaro para custear filme de Jair Bolsonaro: ‘Estarei contigo sempre’
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro requested funds from banker Daniel Vorcaro to finance the film 'Dark Horse', about the life of former president Jair Bolsonaro, with payments already made totaling up to US$ 10 million of a negotiated US$ 24 million. The messages and audio, released by Intercept Brasil and confirmed as authentic by Estadão, were extracted from Vorcaro’s phone during Operation Compliance Zero. Despite the evidence, Flávio denied the financing, calling the claims lies and insisting the funds were private.

item.title: Ligação entre Vorcaro e Flávio é “afetiva e promíscua”, afirma PT
item.description: The PT leader in the Chamber, Pedro Uczai, stated that the audio attributed to Flávio Bolsonaro reveals an 'affective and promiscuous' relationship with Daniel Vorcaro, in which the senator requested R$134 million to finance the film 'Dark Horse' about Jair Bolsonaro. The PT has engaged lawyers to assess legal actions and is pushing for a CPI to investigate Banco Master, questioning the legality of the funds and the consistency of Flávio’s assets, such as a R$6 million mansion, with his declared income.

item.title: Áudio que liga Flávio a Vorcaro acirra ofensiva eleitoral de Lula
item.description: An audio attributed to Flávio Bolsonaro shows him negotiating with jailed banker Daniel Vorcaro to finance a Bolsonaro family film, with $10.6 million transferred between February and May 2025. The PT used the case to reinforce its electoral offensive against the opposition in 2026, linking it to the Bolsonaro family's history and the Banco Master scandal, while Minister José Guimarães urged PF and Justice investigations. A Genial/Quaest poll shows Lula at 42% and Flávio at 41% in a potential runoff, reversing the senator's earlier lead.

item.title: Vorcaro pagou R$ 61 mi a Flávio para bancar filme de Bolsonaro, diz site
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), a pre-candidate for the Brazilian presidency, negotiated with Daniel Vorcaro, former founder of Banco Master, the transfer of US$24 million to finance the film 'Dark Horse', about the life of Jair Bolsonaro. R$61 million were effectively transferred between February and May 2025 through companies and funds linked to Bolsonaro family allies. The senator demanded overdue payments in a September 2025 audio, fearing that defaults would harm the film’s image and that of his father.

item.title: “Flávio é um bandido e a direita não pode ser refém”, diz Kataguiri
item.description: Deputy Kim Kataguiri accused Senator Flávio Bolsonaro of being a "bandit" after an audio surfaced in which the senator demanded payments from banker Daniel Vorcaro related to the production of the film "Dark Horse", about Jair Bolsonaro's political trajectory. Kataguiri stated that the right cannot be held hostage by such actions.

item.title: Medidas de governo Lula para combustíveis custam R$ 2,9 bi por mês
item.description: President Lula's government announced a provisional measure to subsidize gasoline and diesel using federal budget funds, with an estimated monthly cost of up to R$ 2.9 billion for two months, possibly extendable. The subsidy mirrors the reduction of federal taxes such as PIS/Pasep, Cofins, and Cide, and will be paid to producers and importers within 30 days, with discounts reflected in electronic invoices. Despite the significant expense, the government claims the measures will not create fiscal deficits or require tax increases.

item.title: Dólar volta a bater R$ 5 com cenário eleitoral, inflação nos EUA e reportagem sobre Flávio Bolsonaro e Daniel Vorcaro
item.description: The dollar hit R$ 5 following an Intercept Brasil report linking Senator Flávio Bolsonaro to banker Daniel Vorcaro of Banco Master in a bid to raise R$ 134 million for a film about Jair Bolsonaro. The rally was amplified by strong Brazilian retail data, improved approval ratings for Lula in the Genial/Quaest poll, and higher-than-expected U.S. producer inflation, which fueled expectations of further Federal Reserve rate hikes. The Ibovespa fell 1.46% to 177,713 points, while long-term interest rate futures rose sharply, with the January 2029 DI contract at 14.075% and the 2033 contract at 14.20%.

item.title: Aliados de Flávio Bolsonaro estão desnorteados
item.description: The few allies of Flávio Bolsonaro who are still answering calls following the Intercept Brazil report — which included messages and an audio from the senator to his 'brother' Daniel Vorcaro — appear disoriented by the revelation of his involvement with the controversial owner of Banco Master. The subscriber-only exposé has caused discomfort and uncertainty among his closest supporters, raising questions about his political viability.

item.title: Crusoé: O filme amaldiçoado sobre Jair Bolsonaro
item.description: The film Dark Horse, which portrays Jair Bolsonaro, faced financial difficulties and received a request for help from Flávio Bolsonaro to banker Daniel Vorcaro last year, according to an Intercept report. The production, featuring Jim Caviezel, sparked controversy and caused problems for Bolsonaro's supporters.

item.title: Filme sobre Bolsonaro enfrentou denúncias de agressão nos bastidores
item.description: The film 'Dark Horse', depicting Jair Bolsonaro's 2018 presidential campaign, faces allegations of assault, unpaid wages, and poor working conditions from crew members during filming in São Paulo. The accusations, compiled in a dossier by Sated-SP in December 2025, include claims such as actor Bruno Henrique's allegation of being attacked by security for bringing a cellphone onto the set. Funded with approximately R$ 61 million by businessman Daniel Vorcaro, the film is set to premiere on September 11.

item.title: Moraes se declara impedido e 1ª Turma do STF rejeita habeas corpus para Bolsonaro
item.description: The First Chamber of the Supreme Federal Court unanimously rejected a habeas corpus filed by a lawyer not part of Jair Bolsonaro's defense team, seeking to extend his house arrest beyond the 90 days granted by Alexandre de Moraes. Moraes recused himself from the vote, while Ministers Cármen Lúcia, Cristiano Zanin, and Flávio Dino ruled that the petition was inadmissible because the official defense had not authorized it and because Brazilian jurisprudence does not allow habeas corpus against judicial acts of a minister.

item.title: Flávio cai 13 pontos no Polymarket após divulgação de áudio enviado a Vorcaro
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) saw his 2026 presidential election odds drop 13 percentage points on Polymarket after the release of an audio in which he demanded payments from banker Daniel Vorcaro for the production of the film 'Dark Horse'. The audio, published by The Intercept Brasil, raised suspicions of financial irregularities tied to his pre-campaign.

item.title: Flávio já disse que família Bolsonaro não tinha "contato pessoal" com Vorcaro
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro previously denied having 'personal contact' with banker Daniel Vorcaro, but audio and messages revealed by The Intercept show direct conversations between them regarding the financing of the film 'Dark Horse', which received R$61 million from Banco Master. The messages include references to them as 'brothers' and occurred just days before Vorcaro's arrest and the liquidation of Banco Master, contradicting Flávio's statements to CNN. The case raises suspicions of private funds being used for political purposes, tied to Jair Bolsonaro's 2022 campaign.

item.title: PT vai cobrar CPI do Master e usar redes para associar fraudes a Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: The PT is planning to push for the installation of the Master CPI and use social media to link alleged frauds to Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, following the release of audio in which he allegedly demanded over R$130 million from Daniel Vorcaro to finance a film about Jair Bolsonaro. The strategy aims to politically exploit the episode to damage the bolsonarist candidate's image in the 2026 elections.

item.title: Chrisóstomo diz que governo Lula “derrete” e cobra anistia ampla
item.description: Federal Deputy Coronel Chrisóstomo (PL-RO) stated that President Lula's government is 'melting' politically and advocated for the approval of the Amnesty PEC for those involved in the January 8, 2023, acts, proposed by the PL leader in the Chamber. He criticized the federal administration and called for broad amnesty for participants in the events.

item.title: PT prepara PowerPoint para detalhar relação de Flávio X Vorcaro
item.description: PT members plan to release a social media PowerPoint detailing the alleged relationship between Flávio Bolsonaro and businessman Daniel Vorcaro, involving R$61 million from Banco Master to fund the biopic 'Dark Horse' about Jair Bolsonaro. The 'BolsoMaster' strategy aims to link the case to Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, a 2026 presidential pre-candidate, after leaked audio showed discussions between him and Vorcaro about the film. The total negotiated amount was R$134 million, though no evidence confirms the full sum was transferred.

item.title: PT comemora áudio de Flávio com Vorcaro e aposta no "BolsoMaster"
item.description: PT members celebrated the leak of an audio in which Flávio Bolsonaro asks banker Daniel Vorcaro for sponsorship of a film about Jair Bolsonaro, viewing it as a political blow to the Bolsonaro campaign. The PT had previously prepared a strategy linking Flávio to the Banco Master scandal, using the slogan 'Banco Master é Bolso Master', and plans to use the audio to reinforce corruption narratives.

item.title: Interesse em terras raras mudou postura dos EUA ante o Brasil, diz vice-presidente de políticas da Americas Society
item.description: The U.S. interest in rare earths, driven by the threat of Chinese export restrictions, influenced the shift in American posture toward Brazil, according to Brian Winter of the Americas Society. He noted that the Lula-Trump meeting occurred strategically before Trump’s visit to Beijing and urged Brazil to act quickly to capitalize on its rare earth potential, despite bureaucratic delays that could extend project approvals up to ten years.

item.title: Governistas cobram CPMI do Master após suposto áudio de Flávio para Vorcaro
item.description: Government-aligned deputies intensified calls for a Parliamentary Inquiry Commission (CPMI) to investigate the Banco Master scandal following an alleged audio of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro requesting funds from banker Daniel Vorcaro to finance the film 'Dark Horse', which portrays Jair Bolsonaro’s 2018 campaign. According to Intercept Brasil, Vorcaro allegedly paid around R$61 million for the film, part of a reported R$134 million deal. Lawmakers accuse Congress of a 'big deal' to favor corrupt figures and grant amnesty to coup plotters.

item.title: Cármen Lúcia renuncia ao TSE um dia após posse de Kassio; Toffoli deve assumir vaga na corte
item.description: Minister Cármen Lúcia resigned from the Superior Electoral Court (TSE) on Wednesday (13), one day after being replaced as president of the court by Kassio Nunes Marques. Her vacancy is expected to be filled by Minister Dias Toffoli, according to STF expectations.
